messages:
Maya R: Hey team — Sable's onboarding week is next Tue/Thu. Customer asked for a focused enablement session on "inference cost tuning + autoscale". Can we book office hours and a hands-on workshop? Need to propose times, capacity, and pre-read.

Priya K: +1. They flagged renewal in ~60 days; good to surface value asap. Recommend one 60-min demo + 90-min hands-on lab.

Dave S: I'm available for the hands-on but will need GPUs scheduled. Also want an SE to cover Dedicated capacity configs. @Jonah L can you take the lab ops section?

Jonah L: Yep, I can do lab ops. Timezones? Customer is PST (San Francisco) + EMEA engineering on call.

Maya R: Two options: Option A — Tue 11:00am PST (19:00 CET) 60-min demo + 90-min lab same day. Option B — Thu 08:00am PST (16:00 CET) split over two days (demo + lab). Which prefer?

Alex C: I prefer Option B to avoid late night CET. Also suggests limiting lab to 8 seats (sandbox GPU quota).

Priya K: Agreed. Also need a short pre-read: 1) architecture diagram 2) sample prompts/cost baseline 3) checklist to prepare account (API keys + Dedicated access). I'll draft.

Maya R: I'll create the calendar invite after we pick slot. Quick poll — react with :one: for Option A, :two: for Option B, :three: if you prefer staggered demo only + follow-up lab next week.

Dave S: :two: — can we also add a "known risks" slide about renewal signals? I can prepare a 5-min ROI slide.

Jonah L: :two:

Alex C: :two: — keep lab to 75 min if possible, + breakout rooms.

Calendar Bot: Invite created: https://calendar.company/sable-enablement-1719456789 — placeholder.

Maya R: Thanks. @Priya K can you confirm pre-read items and drop links here? Also we need customer success manager to invite the renewal stakeholder — @Keisha P can you take that?

Keisha P: On it. I'll loop in the procurement lead and send the invite once slot confirmed.

Priya K: Drafted pre-read -> https://drive.company/sable-pre-read-v1.md (contains agenda, infra checklist, cost table). Please review.

Dave S: LGTM. For lab environment I'll need the customer's model checkpoint access or we'll use public model. Can we decide?

Alex C: Use public model to avoid data access delays. If they want private model, we can run a "dry run" on Dedicated staging.

Maya R: OK finalizing Option B Thu 08:00am PST — I'll update calendar to confirmed and set capacity 8. Last ask: add a 10-min feedback poll at end and capture renewal sentiment. We'll use short form link.

Jonah L: Cool. I'll prep lab repo and send commands:

```bash
# sandbox spin-up
rwdctl cluster create --name sable-lab --gpus 1 --quota 8
```

Priya K: I'll add the feedback form -> https://forms.company/sable-feedback

Maya R: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll post final invite + prep checklist by EOD.
